title: When 200 OK Is Not an Answer: Silent Fetch Failures in Agentic Web Content Acquisition
abstract: arXiv:2611.00884v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web agents and answer engines fetch pages at question time, and liveness checks of cited sources treat an HTTP 200 response as success. We measure how often that assumption fails and what it does to measurements built on fetched pages. We fetched 10,307 URLs in three days with a polite static client and a rendered browser client: pages from 1,507 sites in five strata, random non-existent paths on every site, and the 4,795 URLs cited by expert-verified claims in ExpertQA. We define a taxonomy of what a 200 response contains, label the static 200 responses automatically, and check the labels against 300 items reviewed by an LLM-based assistant; a human check of 60 of them retained every reviewed usability label after discussion. By the automatic labels, 20.9% of the pages that a static client receives with status 200 do not contain the page's main content: app shells, bot challenges, block pages, error and placeholder pages, and partial

translated_title: 当200 OK不再是答案：智能体网络内容获取中的静默抓取失败
translated_abstract: 网络智能体和答案引擎会在用户提问时抓取网页，而对引用来源进行的活性检查通常将HTTP 200响应视为抓取成功的标志。我们测量了这一假设失效的频率，以及它对基于抓取页面所构建的测量结果的影响。我们在三天内使用礼貌的静态客户端和渲染浏览器客户端抓取了10,307个URL：包括来自五个分层的1,507个站点的页面、每个站点上随机生成的不存在路径，以及ExpertQA中经专家验证的声明所引用的4,795个URL。我们定义了200响应所包含内容的分类体系，自动标记静态抓取的200响应，并将这些标记与由基于大语言模型的助手审核的300个项目进行核对；随后对其中60个项目进行了人工检查，经讨论后保留了所有已审核的可用性标签。根据自动标记的结果，静态客户端收到状态码为200的页面中有20.9%并不包含页面的主要内容：包括应用外壳、机器人挑战页面、封锁页面、错误和占位页面，以及部分……
tldr: 该研究测量了将HTTP 200响应当作抓取成功标志这一假设的失效频率，发现静态客户端抓取的200状态页面中有20.9%实际不含页面主要内容（如应用外壳、反爬挑战、封锁页面等），这会严重误导网络智能体和引用来源活性检查的结果。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies how often the assumption that an HTTP 200 response equals a successful fetch fails, showing that 20.9% of pages returned with status 200 to a static client lack the page's main content—such as app shells, bot challenges, and block pages—which silently corrupts web-agent workflows and citation liveness checks.
